Name: Weather Alert - Tomorrow Forecast and Festival Notifications
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][size=6][b][/b][/size][/center][center][color=#ffff00][size=5]🌦️ Weather Alert – Smart Tomorrow Forecast Notifications[/size]

[size=3][/size][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=downloads][size=4][/size][/url][/color][/center]
[center]Support 13 Languages, German (de) - Thank you [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194134432-jalines/]Jalines[/url]﻿

[size=3]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39848?tab=description]Immersive Weather Overhaul[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868?tab=description]Weather Wonders - Stable


[/url]
[/size][/center][b]Clear, immersive weather alerts for both vanilla and advanced weathers (Weather Wonders supported).
[/b]
Never be surprised by storms, blizzards, heatwaves, or festivals again.
[line]📌 [b]What This Mod Does

[/b]Every morning, this mod displays a [b]clean, atmospheric alert[/b] telling you [b]tomorrow’s weather[/b] — with mood text and gameplay hints.
You’ll see things like:
[list]
[*][b]Rain Tomorrow —[/b] productive, moody skies. Great for crops and fishing.
[*][b]Dry Lightning Tomorrow —[/b] tense, crackling dry air. Good for combat, terrible for fields.
[*][b]Blizzard Tomorrow —[/b] whiteout fury. Mines are safe; foraging is not.
[*][b]Heatwave Tomorrow —[/b] scorching, oppressive heat. Underground work recommended.
[/list]And many more.
Perfect if you like planning routes, watering schedules, skill builds, or preparing buffs ahead of time.
[line]🌤️ [b]Supported Weather Types[/b][b]✔ Vanilla Stardew Weather[/b][list]
[*]Rain
[*]Storm / Lightning
[*]Snow
[*]Wind / Debris
[*]Festival
[*]Wedding (quietly ignored, as intended)
[*]Sunny (no alert)
[/list][b]✔ Weather Wonders (Optional)

[/b]If Weather Wonders is installed, this mod [b]automatically[/b] detects all extended weathers:

[list]
[*]Blizzard
[*]Deluge
[*]Drizzle
[*]Dry Lightning
[*]Hailstorm
[*]Heatwave
[*]Mist
[*]Muddy Rain
[*]Rain–Snow Mix
[*]Acid Rain
[*]Cloudy
[/list]If you [i]don’t[/i] have Weather Wonders, everything still works perfectly — those alerts simply never appear.
[line]🔧 [b]Features

[/b][list]
[*]Clear HUD toast or popup dialogue (configurable)
[*]Toggle alerts per-weather in [code]config.json[/code]
[*]No dependencies
[*]Compatible with all other mods
[*]Does NOT replace art or assets
[*]Zero performance cost
[*]Safe to install or remove mid-save
[/list][line]🔊 [b]Why Use It?

[/b]Stardew Valley’s built-in weather forecast is often:
[list]
[*]easy to miss
[*]vague
[*]buried inside the TV
[*]missing for modded weathers
[/list]This mod fixes all of that with:
✔ [b]quick, readable notifications[/b]
✔ [b]better description text[/b]
✔ [b]actual gameplay guidance[/b]
✔ [b]compatibility with new weather systems[/b]
Good weather planning = smarter farming.

[line]📝 [b]Examples of Alerts

[/b][b]Dry Lightning Tomorrow —[/b] Dangerous, tense, crackling dry air. Great for hardened fighters, terrible for fields.
[b]Muddy Rain Tomorrow —[/b] Heavy, dirty rainfall. Excellent nutrient soil, messy for gathering.
[b]Hailstorm Tomorrow —[/b] Ice pelting the valley. Good for strong fighters, risky for crops.
[b]Cloudy Tomorrow —[/b] Calm, steady overcast. Comfortable day for foraging and fishing.

[line]🎛️ [b]Config Options[/b]Located in:
[code]StardewValley/Mods/WeatherAlertMod/config.json[/code]
Options include:
[list]
[*][code]EnableMod[/code]
[*][code]AlertOnRain[/code]
[*][code]AlertOnStorm[/code]
[*][code]AlertOnSnow[/code]
[*][code]AlertOnWind[/code]
[*][code]AlertOnFestival[/code]
[*][b]Full set for all Weather Wonders weathers[/b]
[*][code]UsePopupDialogue[/code] (instead of HUD toast)
[/list]Everything can be toggled individually.
